info.title: SMB Chatbot Foundation API
info.description: Team baseline contract. Local persistence only; LINE delivery, RAG and AI providers are future integrations. Shop membership is checked on every tenant request.

LineWebhook.description: Each event requires webhookEventId or message.id. Text messages also require nonblank source.userId and message.text. Events and new text jobs commit atomically before success; unsupported events are ignored and cross-shop event ID collisions return 409.

processed_count.description: New text jobs committed durably; duplicates do not count. This does not confirm LINE reply delivery.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque session token from login/register; expires after seven days.
